integrity: Finite exact checks are supplementary to the analytical proof. Same-model review is not independent verification.
scientific_limitations: One inverse riffle step; no mixing-time theorem or convergence rate. Previously published marginal inversion fluctuation laws and Markov martingale tools are credited. The new contribution is the exact conditional cut-size regression and the joint dependence transition. Historic joint inversion identities remain a priority risk.
title: Orthogonal cut sizes and inversions in correlated-label riffle shuffles
